Subject: Decision requested: six-week invoice-handling pilot

Hi Morgan,

I propose a six-week pilot to assess invoice handling for a fixed fee of $30,000. This would keep the engagement focused on assessment, with production rollout explicitly excluded.

The pilot would provide a focused way to evaluate opportunities against your goal of 20% shorter handling time. That figure remains a target—not a promised outcome—as no baseline or measured savings currently exists.

Security approval would be required before any access to client data. No start date has been approved.

Would you approve the six-week pilot scope and $30,000 fixed fee, subject to security clearance? Your approval would give us a clear scope and commercial basis for moving forward while preserving the required security gate.

Best,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
